calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) AS control_net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id' AS chk, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS n FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_return_id', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_web_order', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_not_store900', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order) AND s.store_id<>900
UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_with_no_order_status_ok_but_processing_or_cancelled', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE o.status IN ('processing','cancelled')
UNION ALL SELECT 'store900_lines_without_order', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_returns_in_other_stores', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order) AND s.store_id<>900
UNION ALL SELECT 'store900_returns_of_nonweb', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT s.store_id, f.channel_code, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id,f.line_no)) AS n_keys, MIN(f.sale_date), MAX(f.sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups d ON d.receipt_id=f.receipt_id AND d.line_no=f.line_no
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(r.return_date), MAX(r.return_date), SUM(r.refund_net) AS refund_net
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order) AND s.store_id<>900
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT 'instore_returns_of_web_orders' AS chk, d.fiscal_period AS p, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(r.refund_net) AS v
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order) AND s.store_id<>900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dispatched_null_ts', 0, COUNT(*), 0 FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'test_article_web_lines_in_P5_8', d.fiscal_period, COUNT(*), SUM(f.net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category='ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 5 AND 8 GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2
